description.en: The IDs of the databases that you want to remove.

description.zh:
指定要移除数据库的资产组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostGroups](~~201307~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset group from which you want to remove databases.

> You can call the [ListHostGroups](~~201307~~) operation to query the asset group ID.

description.zh:
要移除数据库的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
要移除数据库的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to manage.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 从指定资产组中批量移除数据库

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost remove-databases-from-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1ghxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --database-ids 1 --region cn-hangzhou
